question: Under what condition is even the wise person described as burning, and by what means is that described?
premises: Reference is made to the tip of nectar.
Reference is made to the tip of essence.
Even the wise person, while burning, is mentioned.
The particle api marks an exception or contrast.
inference: Even the wise person burns when engaged with the tip of nectar by means of the tip of essence.
uncertainties: The syntactic construction is compressed and the agent of burning is not explicit.
plain_english: Even the wise person, burning at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence, also...
